## Summary

- **Keyboard accessibility** — nav links in `+layout.svelte` now show the gold highlight on `:focus-visible`, matching the existing `:hover` style; keyboard users had no visible focus indicator before
- **Named constant** — extracted `DRAFT_SAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS = 300` in `+page.svelte` to replace a bare magic number, making the intent clear and the value easy to change
- **Base64 format detection** — `imageFormatFromBase64` in `image-generation-pipeline.ts` now explicitly checks the PNG header (`iVBORw0KGgo`) and emits a `console.warn` when the prefix is unrecognized, instead of silently falling through to PNG
- **Stale TODO removal** — removed identical `// TODO: Refactor to load from fixture scenarios…` comments from `gallery-store-seam/mock.ts` and `prompt-compiler-seam/mock.ts`; both mocks are correct as-is and the fixture-scenario refactor needs a live probe run (tracked separately)

## Test plan

- [ ] All 416 unit/contract tests pass (`npm run test`)
- [ ] `svelte-check` reports 0 errors (`npm run check`)
- [ ] Tab through nav links in the browser and confirm the gold focus ring appears
- [ ] Verify draft auto-save still fires after editing (debounce behaviour unchanged)
